title: Apple Banana Smoothie
summary: Easy and refreshing, this Apple Banana Smoothie is bursting with natural sweetness. It's the perfect pick-me-up any time of day!
ingredients: 1 medium apple, cored and sliced into chunks
1 tablespoon peanut butter or almond butter (optional)
steps: Add milk and yogurt followed by the rest of the ingredients to a high-speed blender. Blend until smooth!
